cases.what: FORGED caller idempotence proof (central adversarial question)

observed.consequence: a START intent with no COMMIT receipt is proposed for RERUN when the caller merely names the key; the proof VALUE is never validated against any owner, signature, schema or competence

forged_idempotence_verdict.attack: caller supplies {'unit_key': 'anything'} after a crash with a recorded INTENT and no COMMIT
forged_idempotence_verdict.duplicate_execution_risk: REAL — the side effect may already have landed; rerun would duplicate it
forged_idempotence_verdict.required_fix: RERUN_SAFE must require an owner-verified idempotence credential (exact ref + issuer + verified signature/schema), not mere key presence
forged_idempotence_verdict.unresolved_state: UNKNOWN_OUTCOME must remain HELD unless such a credential verifies
